answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake to list services, rising with each extra identity tied to the same hardware attestation. A sybil operator wanting ten fake shops must fund ten stakes and ten attested devices, so cost scales linearly instead of staying flat. Deposits return after clean trades, but a fraud ring caught cheating forfeits all stakes at once, driving the attacker to the nadir once the stake exceeds one fake listing's gain. Reputation then grows on the terrace of verified history: a new account starts at the bottom of the knoll and earns trust through completed work.
